name: Thorns of the Rose Pit
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-12: The Burning of Greensteeples

stealth.note: (or 0 if the trap door is disabled or broken) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Detect Magic]

description: Decorated smooth-hewn flagstone flooring gives way along hidden seams to a 20-foot square, 25-foot-deep pit festooned with spikes and blades of petrified wood in the darkness below.
disable: DC 20 Thievery (trained) to disable the trap door mechanism
reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trap door must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pitfall
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto the trap door

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (typically 10 Bludgeoning Damage damage). That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling.

When creatures fall into the pit, the petrified wood spikes along the floor grow to attempt to plunge into the triggering creature.
